title: Fritzchen II
body: The teacher asks: "Fritzchen, why are you always speaking of our Soviet brothers? It's 'Soviet friends'." Fritz responds: "Well, you can pick your friends."

title: Honecker
body: Honecker meets Mao and asks him: "How many political opponents do you have in China?" Mao: "I estimate about 17 million." Honecker: "Oh, that's pretty much the same here." (The GDR had 17 million inhabitants)

title: Fritzchen III
body: The teacher asks: "Fritzchen, what is the difference between capitalism and socialism?" Fritz replies: "Capitalism is the exploitation of man by man. Under socialism, it is the other way around."

title: 5 Fingers on a Hand
body: "The fact that the GDR considers itself as one of the 5 technologically most advanced power of the nations may be be given to the fact that there are only 5 fingers on a hand. " University lecture in Hungary in the 70s

title: Honecker II
body:
Early in the morning, Honecker arrives at his office and opens his window. He sees the sun and says: "Good morning, dear Sun!" 
The sun replies: "Good morning, dear Erich!" 
Honecker works, and then at noon he heads to the window and says: "Good day, dear Sun!" 
The sun replies: "Good day, dear Erich!" 
In the evening, Erich calls it a day, and heads once more to the window, and says: "Good evening, dear Sun!" 
The sun is silent. 
Honecker says again: "Good evening, dear Sun! What's the matter?" 
The sun replies: "Kiss my ass. I'm in the West now."

title: Honecker III
body: "What's the difference between Honecker and a telephone? None! Hang up and try again."

title: Honecker IV
body:
Honecker and Mielke are discussing their hobbies.
Honecker: "I collect all the jokes about me that are in circulation."
Mielke: "Then we have almost the same hobby. I collect those who bring the jokes into circulation."

title: Stasi
body:
How can you tell that the Stasi has bugged your apartment?
There's a new cabinet in it.

title: Stasi II
body:
Two Stasi agents are on a surveillance mission and quite bored.
First agent: "Hey, what are you thinking about?"
Second agent: "Oh, nothing special. The same as you..."
First agent: "In that case, you're under arrest!"

title: A Cup of Coffee
body:
Guest: "A cup of coffee, please!"
Waiter: "Turkish or filtered?"
Guest: "Why, filtered, of course."
Waiter: "Then you'll have to bring your own filter paper for now."

title: HO-sausage and Sputnik
body:
What's the difference between an HO-sausage and Sputnik?
They've officially confirmed that Sputnik 2 had a dog in it.

title: Goose Meat
body: What was the most-frequently used word at the German-German border? "Goose meat". (GÃ¤nsefleisch, sounds like the first three words in Genn' se vleisch mal 'n Gofferraum offmachn? in the Saxon accent, KÃ¶nnen Sie vielleicht mal den Kofferraum aufmachen? in standard German, which means Could you please open the trunk? )

title: Dieter
body: The doorbell rings. The woman goes to the door and shortly comes back startled and turns to her husband, seeking help: "Dieter! There's a man standing outside who only asks 'TatÃ¼ tata'" (TatÃ¼ tata is onomatopoeia for the sound a police car siren makes). Dieter goes to the door and comes back laughing. "It's my coworker from Saxony, asking "is do Dieta da?" (Ist der Dieter da?, "Is Dieter there?")

title: Have You Caught Any?
body:
A man was fishing. After a while another angler came to join him. "Have you had any bites?" asked the second man.

"Yes, lots," replied the first one, "but they were all mosquitoes."

title: Trabant
body: How do you double the value of a Trabant? Fill up the tank!

title: VEB Sachsenring
body: VEB Sachsenring brought out a new Eco-Trabi: Immediately available for delivery, extremely cheap, extremely quiet, extremely environmentally friendly - with electric power train. Small problem: The extension cord is only 20 meters long and not in stock.

title: Trabant II
body: Did you know they have Knight Rider in the GDR? It's a Trabant with a pocket calculator!

title: Leipzig Trade Fair
body: During a visit to the Leipzig Trade Fair, a filthy rich oil sheik heard that there is a car with a delivery time of over ten years. Since Rolls Royce usually delivers more quickly than that, it must be quite an exceptional car, which he would certainly have to have in his collection. Sight unseen, he made a request to order this Trabant. In Zwickau, they're aware of this great honor, so they immediately change the running Five-Year Plan and bring forward a specimen. In the container, the car reaches the emirate in a handful of weeks. The happy oil sheik immediately called his friends together, opened the container, and exclaimed in surprise: "Gosh, they have incredibly long delivery times, but at least they send you a cardboard model in advance â and the best, you can even drive it!"

title: Mercedes
body: A West German businessman is driving a Mercedes through East Germany on a rainy night when his windshield wipers stop working. He takes it to an East German mechanic, who tells him there are no Mercedes windshield wiper motors in the GDR, but he will do his best to fix it. When the businessman returns the next day, to his surprise the windshield wipers are working perfectly. "How did you find a Mercedes windshield wiper motor in the East?" he asks the mechanic. "We didn't," replies the mechanic, "We used the engine motor of a Trabant."

title: Bananas in the West
body: Why are there so many bananas in the West? Because the Westerners are descended from apes.

title: Cow's Tail
body: What's the difference between a Western necktie and a cow's tail? The cow's tail covers the whole asshole.

title: Der Dumme Rest
body: At the peak of the wave of East Germans fleeing through Hungary and Czechoslovakia in 1989, the persons still staying in East Germany (DDR) were called the "Der Dumme Rest" (the dumb remains).

title: Ossi With a Wessi
body: What do you get when you cross an Ossi with a Wessi? An arrogant unemployed person.

title: Elephant in the Bathtub
body:
Q: How can you tell that an elephant is in the bathtub with you? 
A: By the smell of peanuts on its breath.

title: Paint Toes Yellow
body:
Q: Why do elephants paint their toes yellow? 
A: So they can hide upside down in the custard.

title: Police Station
body:
Q: What did the Dallas chief of police say when the elephant walked into the police station? 
A: Nothing! He didn't notice.

title: Big Ears
body:
Q: Why do elephants have big ears? 
A: Because Noddy would not pay the ransom!

title: Blue Elephant
body:
Q: How do you shoot a blue elephant? 
A: With a blue elephant gun.

title: Yellow Elephant
body:
Q: How do you shoot a yellow elephant? 
A: Have you ever seen a yellow elephant?

title: Red Elephant
body:
Q: How do you shoot a red elephant? 
A: Hold his trunk shut until he turns blue, and then shoot him with the blue elephant gun.

title: Purple Elephant
body:
Q: How do you shoot a purple elephant? 
A: Paint him red, hold his trunk shut until he turns blue, and then shoot him with the blue elephant gun.

title: Fit Into a Mini
body:
Q: How many elephants will fit into a Mini? 
A: Four: Two in the front, two in the back.

title: Giraffes Fit Into a Mini
body:
Q: How many giraffes will fit into a Mini? 
A: None. It's full of elephants.

title: Whales in a Mini
body:
Q: How do you get two whales in a Mini? 
A: Along the M4 and across the Severn Bridge.

title: Two Elephants in Your Refrigerator
body:
Q: How do you know there are two elephants in your refrigerator? 
A: You can hear giggling when the light goes out.

title: Three Elephants in Your Refrigerator
body:
Q: How do you know there are three elephants in your refrigerator? 
A: You can't close the door.

title: Four Elephants in Your Refrigerator
body:
Q: How do you know there are four elephants in your refrigerator? 
A: There's an empty Mini parked outside.

title: Baby Elephants
body:
What do elephants have that nothing else has? 

Baby elephants!

title: Brown Legs and Trunk
body:
Q: What is brown, has four legs, and a trunk? 
A: A mouse coming back from vacation.

title: Eight Legs
body:
Q: What has eight legs, two trunks, four eyes, and two tails? 
A: Two elephants.

title: Big, Grey and Wrinkly
body:
Q: Why is an elephant big, grey and wrinkly? 
A: Because if it was small, white and hard it would be an aspirin.

title: Small and White
body:
Why are golf balls small and white?

Because if they were big and grey they would be elephants.

title: Elephant and Plum
body:
Q: What's the difference between an elephant and a plum? 
A: Their color.

title: One Day, Huh?
body: If I had only one day left to live, I would live it in my Social Studies class; it would seem so much longer.

title: Elephants Coming
body:
Q: What did Tarzan say to Jane when he saw the elephants coming? 
A: Here come the elephants.

title: Elephants Coming II
body:
Q: What did Jane say to Tarzan when she saw the elephants coming? 
A: Here come the plums; she was color blind.

title: Big, Grey, Quarts
body:
Q: What is big and grey and comes in quarts? 
A: An elephant.

title: Heaven and Hell
body:
Heaven is where the police are British, the cooks French, the mechanics German, the lovers Italian, and it is all organized by the Swiss. 
Hell is where the chefs are British, the mechanics French, the lovers Swiss, the police German, and it is all organized by the Italians.

title: Wenn Ist Das...
body: Wenn ist das Nunstruck git und Slotermeyer? Ja! Beiherhund das Oder die Flipperwaldt gersput!

title: Hit a Woman
body: Would you hit a woman with a baby? No, I'd hit her with a brick.
